newsitem.title: FRANCE: French SNCF rail boss attacks EU liberalisation.
newsitem.headline: French SNCF rail boss attacks EU liberalisation.

text.p: French SNCF rail chairman Louis Gallois said on Thursday he opposed the rail liberalisation ideas espoused in a European Commission "White Paper" on the future of the railways in the European Union.

"The White Paper lays out ideas which I subscribe to when it comes to underlining the positive and essential contribution from the railways, the public service mandate or which seeks to clarify the duties of those in charge of the infrastructure and the operators," Gallois said in an interview in Le Monde.
"However, I do not agree at all with its ill-judged ideas on liberalisation," Gallois told the afternoon daily.
The SNCF boss also said he would like, where possible and where increased traffic justified it, to lower SNCF prices to better compete with road and air rivals.
